title: Chapter 114: Strange Intervention
content:
Chapter 114: Strange Intervention

The anti-aircraft tower destroyed some of the ghouls that rushed out, and the remaining ghouls jumped to the ground and were strangled by the spikes that came out from the ground.

The defensive buildings in the Zerg underground base were all upgraded to one star, and the attack power and attack range were improved. It was a waste of resources to deal with so few ghouls.

The ghouls kept drilling holes in the rock wall, and the Zerg defensive buildings were waiting for them to come out and kill them one by one, not afraid of waste at all.

The defensive buildings located on the Zerg fungal blanket had the energy support of the entire Zerg and could attack without limit.

The ghouls rushed out in batches to die, and only the defensive buildings were attacking on the Zerg side, and no other Zerg were seen.

This state did not last long, and the rock wall that kept drilling out ghouls suddenly collapsed, and behind it was a huge cave that had been hollowed out, and a large number of ghouls were crowded inside.

As soon as the cave opened, the ghouls rushed down like a mountain torrent, rushing towards the Zerg base.

Faced with the ghouls' attack, the many defensive spikes that were originally slow in their movements suddenly opened fire, and countless spike forests suddenly grew on the road where the ghouls were charging!

All the dense defensive spikes nearby launched a full-force attack!

The dense spikes instantly blocked the ghouls' charge, and almost all the ghouls within the attack range of the defensive spikes were stabbed into the air by the spikes.

When the spikes fell, a large number of ghouls turned into light and disappeared. The ghouls who were only injured but not killed had no time to rejoice, and they were stabbed into the sky by a forest of spikes before they completely landed.

The defensive spikes attacked alternately for three rounds, and all the ghouls that rushed into their attack range turned into light and disappeared, leaving no one behind.

The powerful spikes of the anti-aircraft towers attacked the dense ghouls in the exposed huge cave at the highest firing rate. One thick spike was enough to penetrate a string of ghouls!

The ghouls in the cave continued to charge, and the defensive spikes kept attacking. Their attack intensity was just kept at a level that the ghouls could not rush through.

The combined defense of the defensive spikes and the anti-aircraft towers caused the number of ghouls to decrease rapidly. If the ghouls only attacked with this intensity, they would be sending themselves to death.

There are wise men among these ghouls, and they are very good at learning. Now they must have their reasons for attacking in this way.

Sure enough, not far from the huge cave, another stone wall fell down completely, revealing an even larger space, and more ghouls rushed towards the Zerg base.

"This ghoul's digging efficiency is so high? It feels a little abnormal!"

Wu Qing doubted the ghoul's digging ability. Even if the Zerg used a large number of worker bees to dig, they could not achieve this level in such a short time.

Several one-star hosts flew a distance in the direction of the ghouls' attack, and found that there were some strange things helping the ghouls to dig rocks and soil through the thick rock and soil layer.

There were a lot of those strange things, and the digging speed was very fast. From the passage that the Zerg actively closed to the Zerg underground base, the soil and rocks in the middle were almost dug out.

As long as all these soil and rocks were dug out, it was equivalent to greatly widening the space of the Zerg underground base. Those spaces outside the Zerg's defense range had gathered a large number of ghouls.

Once opened up, it was equivalent to the Zerg's geographical and defensive advantages were gone, and the two sides became a head-on confrontation.

"These things should be a kind of weirdness! It turns out that the weirdness is playing tricks!"

Wu Qing didn't expect that the creatures in this world could coexist with weirdness and help each other!

All the Zerg Hydralisks came out from under the fungal blanket, and with the newly added Hydralisks later, the total number of Hydralisks is now close to 8,000.

Many worker bees went to the rear of the first defense circle of the Zerg underground base, quickly built reproductive bodies, and then evolved into defensive spikes and anti-aircraft towers, and then upgraded them.

With sufficient resources, another circle of one-star defense buildings in the Zerg underground base was built.

The consumed worker bees were hatched and replenished from the nearby mother nests. After precise calculations, the queen continued to replenish defense buildings in the Zerg underground base, making the entire underground base airtight.

The Zerg has seen the terrifying number of ghouls, and now there is a strange intervention. The Zerg territory must enter the strongest defense state.

In the Zerg territory on the ground, Wu Qing upgraded all the defense buildings to one star at once, and asked the queen to build some defense buildings, further strengthening the defense of the Zerg ground territory.

It is not safe underground, and the ground must also be prepared.

Wu Qing chose ten mother nests in the Zerg territory to upgrade to one star, and the number of one-star mother nests in the entire Zerg territory reached thirty.

The mother nest never stops, and all the troops are sent out at full strength. The queen will give priority to hatching hydralisks according to the amount of gas resources. Wu Qing's request is to reserve a certain amount of spare gas resources, and use the rest to hatch hydralisks.

When gas resources are insufficient, all efforts will be made to hatch puppies.

…

Nearly 8,000 hydralisks are roaming and maneuvering in groups in the Zerg underground base, and they will provide support wherever there are enemies.

The puppies have drilled into the ground early and lurked in various positions of the base, especially the first line of defense, which is full of puppies lurking and waiting underground.

For the newly hatched Zerg, the hydralisks will directly join the team, and the puppies will find empty positions to burrow into the ground and lurk, leaving space for the hydralisks to quickly maneuver and fight.

In the direction of the ghouls' attack, the Zerg defense buildings were already full of hydralisks. They assisted the defense buildings in attacking the ghouls that kept pouring out of the two large caves, quickly eliminating the enemies, collecting resources for the system, and supporting the Zerg's construction upgrades and continuous mass production.

Because the weirdness could not enter the lord's shelter area, that is, it could not enter the Zerg territory, the soil and rocks on the edge of the Zerg territory needed to be dug by the ghouls themselves, which would waste a lot of time.

They made two caves and continuously sent troops to attack, probably to attract the attention of the Zerg and interfere with the Zerg's discovery of their big moves.

Unfortunately, they underestimated the Zerg's detection ability. The powerful detection ability of the one-star host allowed it to detect the enemy's movements through layers of soil and rocks at a longer distance.

The ghouls didn't know yet that the Zerg had already seen through their conspiracy.

Wu Qing was not in a hurry. The night was long, and the Zerg had plenty of time to wait slowly.

It was easy to fight against the zombies that kept coming to the door. Wu Qing watched the system resources increase continuously and then turn into the strength of the Zerg. It felt very good!
